pub mod emc {
// EMC values: the static table tools/gen_emc.py wrote from ProjectE's
// default mapping.

use super::emc_table::{DURABILITY, EMC};

/// An item's EMC, None for an item without one (it can't be learned or burned).
pub fn value(item: &str) -> Option<u64> {
    EMC.binary_search_by(|(k, _)| (*k).cmp(item)).ok().map(|i| EMC[i].1)
}

/// What one item of a stack is worth: a worn tool loses value with its wear,
/// as ProjectE's DamageProcessor scales it (`max_damage` 0 for an item that
/// doesn't wear). None when the item has no EMC or is worth nothing left.
pub fn stack_value(item: &str, damage: u32, max_damage: u32) -> Option<u64> {
    let v = value(item)?;
    if max_damage == 0 || damage == 0 {
        return Some(v);
    }
    let left = max_damage.saturating_sub(damage) as u128;
    let scaled = (v as u128 * left / max_damage as u128) as u64;
    (scaled > 0).then_some(scaled)
}

/// How much wear an item takes before it breaks, 0 for one that doesn't wear
/// (a table of the items with EMC, as no helper reads an item's durability).
pub fn max_damage(item: &str) -> u32 {
    DURABILITY.binary_search_by(|(k, _)| (*k).cmp(item)).map_or(0, |i| DURABILITY[i].1)
}

/// Every item with an EMC value, for the Tome of Knowledge.
pub fn all_items() -> impl Iterator<Item = &'static str> {
    EMC.iter().map(|(k, _)| *k)
}

/// A number as ProjectE shows it: 1,234,567.
pub fn format(n: u128) -> String {
    let s = n.to_string();
    let mut out = String::new();
    for (i, c) in s.chars().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 && (s.len() - i) % 3 == 0 {
            out.push(',');
        }
        out.push(c);
    }
    out
}
}

pub mod knowledge {
// A player's transmutation knowledge: their EMC and the items they have
// learned (ProjectE's IKnowledgeProvider), and their alchemical bags. Saved
// as a small text file in the world's folder, one per player.

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};

use super::emc;

pub const BAG_SLOTS: usize = 54;

/// A plain stack kept in a bag: item, count, damage.
pub type Plain = (String, u32, u32);

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Knowledge {
    pub emc: u128,
    pub known: BTreeSet<String>,
    /// The 16 alchemical bags (by colour), BAG_SLOTS slots each.
    pub bags: BTreeMap<u8, Vec<Option<Plain>>>,
}

impl Knowledge {
    /// Burns `count` of `item`, each worth `each`: its EMC goes to the player
    /// and they learn it. False (nothing changes) for an item worth nothing.
    pub fn burn(&mut self, item: &str, count: u32, each: u64) -> bool {
        if each == 0 || count == 0 || emc::value(item).is_none() {
            return false;
        }
        self.emc += each as u128 * count as u128;
        self.learn(item);
        true
    }

    /// Learns an item with an EMC value; whether it was new.
    pub fn learn(&mut self, item: &str) -> bool {
        emc::value(item).is_some() && self.known.insert(item.to_string())
    }

    pub fn forget(&mut self, item: &str) -> bool {
        self.known.remove(item)
    }

    /// Takes up to `want` of a known item, as many as the player's EMC pays
    /// for: how many they get.
    pub fn withdraw(&mut self, item: &str, want: u32) -> u32 {
        let Some(v) = emc::value(item).filter(|_| self.known.contains(item)) else { return 0 };
        let n = (self.emc / v as u128).min(want as u128) as u32;
        self.emc -= n as u128 * v as u128;
        n
    }

    /// The Tome of Knowledge: every item with EMC.
    pub fn learn_all(&mut self) -> usize {
        let before = self.known.len();
        self.known.extend(emc::all_items().map(str::to_string));
        self.known.len() - before
    }

    /// Known items, the dearest first (as ProjectE's table sorts them), then by id.
    pub fn sorted(&self, filter: &str) -> Vec<&str> {
        let mut v: Vec<&str> = self
            .known
            .iter()
            .map(String::as_str)
            .filter(|i| filter.is_empty() || i.contains(filter))
            .collect();
        v.sort_by(|a, b| emc::value(b).cmp(&emc::value(a)).then(a.cmp(b)));
        v
    }

    pub fn bag(&mut self, color: u8) -> &mut Vec<Option<Plain>> {
        let b = self.bags.entry(color).or_default();
        b.resize(BAG_SLOTS, None);
        b
    }

    pub fn save(&self) -> String {
        let mut out = format!("emc {}\n", self.emc);
        for k in &self.known {
            out.push_str(&format!("known {k}\n"));
        }
        for (c, slots) in &self.bags {
            for (i, s) in slots.iter().enumerate() {
                if let Some((item, n, d)) = s {
                    out.push_str(&format!("bag {c} {i} {item} {n} {d}\n"));
                }
            }
        }
        out
    }

    /// Reads `save`'s text; lines it doesn't know are skipped.
    pub fn load(text: &str) -> Self {
        let mut k = Knowledge::default();
        for line in text.lines() {
            let mut w = line.split_whitespace();
            match w.next() {
                Some("emc") => k.emc = w.next().and_then(|v| v.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0),
                Some("known") => {
                    if let Some(i) = w.next() {
                        k.known.insert(i.to_string());
                    }
                }
                Some("bag") => {
                    let f: Vec<&str> = w.collect();
                    if let [c, i, item, n, d] = f[..] {
                        if let (Ok(c), Ok(i), Ok(n), Ok(d)) = (c.parse::<u8>(), i.parse::<usize>(), n.parse(), d.parse())
                        {
                            if i < BAG_SLOTS {
                                k.bag(c)[i] = Some((item.to_string(), n, d));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        k
    }
}
}

// The transmutation table's menu: a six-row chest menu the server fills.
// Rows 1-5 are the player's known items, a page at a time; the bottom row
// has the page buttons and the EMC line. Clicks on the player's own
// inventory below burn what was clicked.

use super::knowledge::Knowledge;

pub const ROWS: u8 = 6;
pub const SIZE: usize = 54;
pub const GRID: usize = 45;
pub const PREV: usize = 45;
pub const INFO: usize = 49;
pub const NEXT: usize = 53;

/// What a click in the menu asks for.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Click {
    /// Take `count` of a known item.
    Withdraw { item: String, count: u32 },
    /// Burn the stack in the player's inventory slot (0..9 the hotbar):
    /// all of it, or one.
    Burn { slot: usize, all: bool },
    /// Fill (`true`) or empty (`false`) the Klein star in that inventory slot.
    Star { slot: usize, fill: bool },
    Forget(String),
    Page(isize),
    None,
}

pub fn pages(known: usize) -> usize {
    known.div_ceil(GRID).max(1)
}

/// The known items shown on `page` (clamped to the last page).
pub fn page_items<'a>(k: &'a Knowledge, page: usize) -> Vec<&'a str> {
    let all = k.sorted("");
    let page = page.min(pages(all.len()) - 1);
    all.into_iter().skip(page * GRID).take(GRID).collect()
}

/// Reads a click: `slot` counts the menu's 54 slots, then the player's
/// inventory (`inventory_slot` maps those), `button` and `mode` as vanilla's
/// container click (mode 0 a click, 1 a shift-click), `max_stack` the
/// clicked item's stack size, `is_star` whether the clicked inventory item
/// is a Klein star.
pub fn click(
    k: &Knowledge,
    page: usize,
    slot: i32,
    button: i32,
    mode: i32,
    inventory_slot: Option<usize>,
    is_star: bool,
    max_stack: u32,
) -> Click {
    if mode > 1 {
        return Click::None;
    }
    if let Some(inv) = inventory_slot {
        if is_star {
            return Click::Star { slot: inv, fill: button == 1 };
        }
        return Click::Burn { slot: inv, all: button == 0 || mode == 1 };
    }
    let Ok(s) = usize::try_from(slot) else { return Click::None };
    match s {
        PREV => Click::Page(-1),
        NEXT => Click::Page(1),
        s if s < GRID => {
            let Some(item) = page_items(k, page).get(s).map(|i| i.to_string()) else { return Click::None };
            match (mode, button) {
                (1, 1) => Click::Forget(item),
                (1, _) | (0, 1) => Click::Withdraw { item, count: max_stack.max(1) },
                _ => Click::Withdraw { item, count: 1 },
            }
        }
        _ => Click::None,
    }
}
}

        match (self, to) {

            (Device::Relay(_), Device::Condenser(_)) => true,

/// Splits `offer` among targets that can each take `room[i]`: an even share
/// each (ProjectE's `emc / targets.size()`), what one can't take staying put.
pub fn share(offer: i64, room: &[i64]) -> Vec<i64> {
    if room.is_empty() || offer <= 0 {
        return vec![0; room.len()];
    }
    let each = offer / room.len() as i64;
    room.iter().map(|r| each.min(*r).max(0)).collect()
}

/// One tick of a condenser.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Condensed {
    /// (slot, how many) taken out and turned into EMC.
    pub consumed: Vec<(usize, u32)>,
    /// Copies of the target made.
    pub produced: u32,
    pub stored: i64,
}

/// A condenser's tick: with a target worth `target_value`, it turns what it
/// holds into EMC (the MK1 one item a tick, the MK2 every input stack at
/// once) and EMC into the target, while `room` more fit (the MK1 one a
/// tick, the MK2 as many as it can pay for). `inputs` are (slot, count,
/// value of one; 0 for an item without EMC or the target itself).
pub fn condense(mk2: bool, target_value: u64, stored: i64, inputs: &[(usize, u32, u64)], room: u32) -> Condensed {
    let mut out = Condensed { stored, ..Default::default() };
    if target_value == 0 {
        return out;
    }
    let tv = target_value as i64;
    for &(slot, count, value) in inputs {
        if value == 0 || count == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        if mk2 {
            out.consumed.push((slot, count));
            out.stored = out.stored.saturating_add(value as i64 * count as i64);
        } else if out.stored < tv {
            out.consumed.push((slot, 1));
            out.stored += value as i64;
            break;
        }
    }
    while out.produced < room && out.stored >= tv {
        out.stored -= tv;
        out.produced += 1;
        if !mk2 {
            break;
        }
    }
    out
}
}

pub mod area {
// The blocks an item reaches: the philosopher's stone's cube, panel or line
// around the block clicked, and the matter tools' wider digs.

use super::world_table::WORLD;

/// The philosopher's stone's result for a block: sneaking takes the other way round.
pub fn transmute(block: &str, sneaking: bool) -> Option<&'static str> {
    let i = WORLD.binary_search_by(|(o, _, _)| (*o).cmp(block)).ok()?;
    let (_, result, alt) = WORLD[i];
    Some(if sneaking { alt } else { result })
}

/// Positions the philosopher's stone changes: charge 0 is the block itself,
/// each charge one block further out. Mode 0 a cube, 1 a panel facing the
/// clicked face, 2 a line going into the block from that face.
pub fn stone_area(pos: [i32; 3], face: [i32; 3], charge: i32, mode: i32) -> Vec<[i32; 3]> {
    let r = charge.max(0);
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    match mode {
        1 => {
            for a in -r..=r {
                for b in -r..=r {
                    out.push(plane(pos, face, a, b));
                }
            }
        }
        2 => {
            for d in 0..=(r * 2) {
                out.push([pos[0] - face[0] * d, pos[1] - face[1] * d, pos[2] - face[2] * d]);
            }
        }
        _ => {
            for dx in -r..=r {
                for dy in -r..=r {
                    for dz in -r..=r {
                        out.push([pos[0] + dx, pos[1] + dy, pos[2] + dz]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    out
}

/// A point `a`, `b` across the plane through `pos` square to `face`.
fn plane(pos: [i32; 3], face: [i32; 3], a: i32, b: i32) -> [i32; 3] {
    if face[1] != 0 {
        [pos[0] + a, pos[1], pos[2] + b]
    } else if face[0] != 0 {
        [pos[0], pos[1] + a, pos[2] + b]
    } else {
        [pos[0] + a, pos[1] + b, pos[2]]
    }
}

/// The extra blocks a matter tool breaks with `pos`, other than `pos`:
/// a pickaxe's mode (1 tall, 2 wide, 3 long: three in a row), a hammer's or
/// shovel's square of side `2 * charge + 1` on the face dug.
pub fn dig_area(kind: &str, pos: [i32; 3], face: [i32; 3], charge: i32, mode: i32, facing: [i32; 3]) -> Vec<[i32; 3]> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    match kind {
        "pick" => match mode {
            1 => out.extend([[pos[0], pos[1] + 1, pos[2]], [pos[0], pos[1] - 1, pos[2]]]),
            2 => {
                // Sideways to where the player looks.
                let side = [facing[2], 0, -facing[0]];
                out.extend([
                    [pos[0] + side[0], pos[1], pos[2] + side[2]],
                    [pos[0] - side[0], pos[1], pos[2] - side[2]],
                ]);
            }
            3 => out.extend([
                [pos[0] - face[0], pos[1] - face[1], pos[2] - face[2]],
                [pos[0] - 2 * face[0], pos[1] - 2 * face[1], pos[2] - 2 * face[2]],
            ]),
            _ => {}
        },
        "hammer" | "shovel" | "morning_star" | "katar" => {
            let r = charge.max(0);
            if kind == "hammer" && mode == 0 && r == 0 {
                return out;
            }
            for a in -r..=r {
                for b in -r..=r {
                    let p = plane(pos, face, a, b);
                    if p != pos {
                        out.push(p);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    out
}
}
